reading.title: The Message Capsule
reading.intro_zh: 这篇短文把 Lesson 22 的“偶然连接变成稳定通信”换到安全的学校交流项目：不是鼓励把瓶子扔进海里，而是用老师安排的 message capsule 和邮局通信，回收 dreamed of / of her own age / Channel / address / bottle / regularly / each other / post office / a little more / faster。
passage: At the school museum, Mia joined a safe exchange project called the Message Capsule. Each student wrote a short note and placed it in a clear plastic tube on a postcard wall. Mia never dreamed of hearing from anyone. Two weeks later, her teacher handed her a card from Lena, a girl of her own age in a coastal town near the Channel. Lena had picked Mia's note because both girls liked maps and old bottle stories. They did not share home addresses; the school office kept the address list. At first they sent notes through the project box, but the box was opened only once a month. Now they write to each other regularly through the post office. Stamps cost a little more, but the letters certainly travel faster.

questions.question: What kind of chance message started Mia and Lena's connection?
options: A note in a safe school Message Capsule project.
A glass bottle thrown into the sea.
A message posted on a public social media page.
A letter sent by Lena's parents.
questions.explanation_zh: 开头说 Mia joined a safe exchange project called the Message Capsule，并把 note 放进 postcard wall 上的透明管里。

questions.question: Why did Lena's reply feel special to Mia?
options: Because Lena was a girl of her own age and they both liked maps and old bottle stories.
Because Lena lived in Mia's own street.
Because Lena sent Mia an expensive present.
Because Lena already knew Mia's home address.
questions.explanation_zh: 短文说 Lena was a girl of her own age，而且 both girls liked maps and old bottle stories，所以这次回复有相似感。

questions.question: How do the two girls communicate regularly now?
options: They write to each other through the post office.
They wait beside the postcard wall every day.
They put new tubes into the sea.
They ask the museum to read every note aloud.
questions.explanation_zh: 结尾说 Now they write to each other regularly through the post office。

questions.question: Why is the post office better than the project box?
options: The project box was opened only once a month, but letters travel faster.
The post office is free, but the project box costs a little more.
The project box can only send maps.
The post office lets children share home addresses with strangers.
questions.explanation_zh: project box 一个月才打开一次；邮票 cost a little more，但 letters certainly travel faster。

questions.question: What is the main idea of the story?
options: Chance can start a connection, but a reliable way keeps it going.
Children should throw bottles into the sea to make friends.
A postcard wall is always faster than the post office.
Two friends should stop writing when stamps cost money.
questions.explanation_zh: 这个拓展故事的核心和 Lesson 22 一样：偶然的开始很有惊喜，但长期联系需要稳定、可靠的方法。

writing.intro_zh: 今天抓五个 Lesson 22 的通信句式：never dreamed of ...ing 写意外惊喜，of her own age 写同龄人，never thought of it again 写被忘记的小动作，write to each other regularly 写稳定互通，will certainly ... faster 写实际比较。

patterns.title: never dreamed of ...ing
patterns.source: Jane never dreamed of receiving a letter from a girl of her own age in Holland.
patterns.focus_zh: 用 never dreamed of 加动名词，写某人完全没想到会发生的惊喜。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：写你从没想到会收到某人的卡片、消息或邀请。
patterns.sample: I never dreamed of receiving a postcard from a student in another city.
patterns.tip_zh: of 后面要接动名词形式，比如 receiving、meeting、finding。

patterns.title: of one's own age
patterns.source: a girl of her own age
patterns.focus_zh: 这个短语用来说明“和某人差不多大”，比只说 same age 更有课文味道。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：写一个同龄男孩、女孩或学生让你觉得更容易交流。
patterns.sample: I felt relaxed when I met a boy of my own age.
patterns.tip_zh: 写别人时可以换成 of his own age 或 of her own age；写自己时用 of my own age。

patterns.title: never thought of it again
patterns.source: She never thought of it again.
patterns.focus_zh: 这个句子适合写一个小动作做完就忘了，后来却带来结果。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：写某人寄出一张卡片、留下一个便条或参加一个活动后，就再也没想过它。
patterns.sample: Mia put her note in the capsule and never thought of it again.
patterns.tip_zh: it 要指代前面提到的那件小事；这样故事才有“后来突然回来”的感觉。

patterns.title: write to each other regularly
patterns.source: They write to each other regularly now.
patterns.focus_zh: write to each other 表示双方互相写；regularly 表示稳定、反复地做。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：写两个朋友现在定期互相写信、发邮件或交换明信片。
patterns.sample: The two pen pals write to each other regularly every month.
patterns.tip_zh: each other 不能只写单向动作；句子里要看得出两个人都在回应。

patterns.title: will certainly ... faster
patterns.source: Letters will cost a little more, but they will certainly travel faster.
patterns.focus_zh: 这个句式用来做实际比较：前半句承认成本，后半句强调更快、更可靠。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：写一种方法会多花一点钱或时间，但肯定更快、更安全或更可靠。
patterns.sample: The express letter will cost a little more, but it will certainly arrive faster.
patterns.tip_zh: but 后面要给出实际好处；faster 前面可以搭配 arrive、travel、work 等动词。
